title: All Is One
coreMove: Stillness grows when you widen the frame: see your life inside one shared world, then let that view change the next small duty in front of you.

exampleSpecs.domain: city emergency briefing after a river flood
exampleSpecs.audience: readers under pressure to protect their own group first
exampleSpecs.stakes: a blame-heavy message may win aid but split the towns that share the same river
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Presley uses Apollo 8 and Earthrise to widen the frame before choosing her public sentence

exampleSpecs.domain: school hallway after a student conflict
exampleSpecs.audience: readers who need the lesson to emerge through conversation
exampleSpecs.stakes: a hallway fight can become a tribal story unless adults widen the frame
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Hazel and Tobias let the wider-frame lesson shape a practical response

exampleSpecs.domain: museum exhibit opening for an Earthrise photograph
exampleSpecs.audience: readers who expect wonder to stay private
exampleSpecs.stakes: the exhibit could become mere awe unless the view changes conduct
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Chantal expects silence but finds local repair prompted by Earthrise

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who need a compressed informal scene
exampleSpecs.stakes: a building chat can turn one leaky ceiling into a private grievance
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a short thread shows the shared-roof frame without turning it into a sermon

exampleSpecs.domain: bakery supply call after a missed delivery
exampleSpecs.audience: readers whose routine gets interrupted by irritation
exampleSpecs.stakes: an angry call may solve one invoice and poison the working chain
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A bakery call begins from the shared chain rather than blame.

exampleSpecs.domain: apartment laundry room after a long workday
exampleSpecs.audience: readers who learn through one small observed moment
exampleSpecs.stakes: ordinary shared spaces reveal whether oneness has become conduct
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Hamza's small act shows the wider-frame lesson as lived responsibility
